title: A Wide Evaluation of ChatGPT on Affective Computing Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating ChatGPT models on various affective computing tasks such as sentiment analysis, emotion intensity ranking, suicide tendency detection, toxicity detection, well-being assessment, engagement measurement, personality assessment, sarcasm detection, and subjectivity detection.
